title: M-C082126-02 PowerGADS and Stakeholder Login Portal access for Resource Entities representing Generation Resources

documents.text:
Market Notice Details

To:

Notice_Operations@lists.ercot.com

Sent:

11/23/26, 5:06 PM

Subject:

M-C082126-02 PowerGADS and Stakeholder Login Portal access for Resource Entities representing Generation Resources

NOTICE DATE:
 November 23, 2026

NOTICE TYPE: 
M-C082126-02 Operations

SHORT DESCRIPTION:
 PowerGADS and Stakeholder Login Portal access for Resource Entities representing Generation Resources

INTENDED AUDIENCE:
 PowerGADS users and User Security Administrators (USAs) from Resource Entities Registered with NERC

DAYS AFFECTED:
 December 4, 2026 - Onward

LONG DESCRIPTION: 
As mentioned in the attached previous Notice distributed on August 21, 2026 (M-C082126-01), ERCOT is implementing a new process for acquiring Generating Availability Data System (GADS) data for studies mandated by the Public Utility Commission of Texas and North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC). ERCOT acquired PowerGADS, a web-based GADS data collection and management tool. PowerGADS will be available for Resource Entities on 
December 4, 2026.
 Secure access to PowerGADS will be managed through a new 
Stakeholder Login Portal
* that will allow users to securely log in to PowerGADS and access authorized application features, create passwords, set up and manage Multi Factor Authentication (MFA) methods,
 login to 
Market Participant Identity Management (MPIM) for the USA 
to assign PowerGADS entitlements to users.

Resource Entity USAs will be able to login to the Market Participant Identity Management (MPIM) application to assign PowerGADS entitlements to users.

*PowerGADS is the first application to use the new Stakeholder Login Portal. This limited launch for Resource Entity users lets ERCOT exercise account creation, Multi Factor Authentication sign-in, and supporting back-end components with a small group of users before larger applications follow, beginning with the Market Participant Service Portal (MPSP) in 2027, which will reach all Market Participants.

NOTE FOR RESOURCE ENTITIES REGISTERED WITH NERC: Change from the August 21, 2026 Notice

There is a change from the August 21, 2026 Notice (M-C082126-01) attached to this Market Notice. 
Resource Entities are no longer required to fill out the PowerGADS user account information form
 or email it to 
GADSSubmissions@ercot.com
 to set up user accounts in PowerGADS. 
User Security Administrators (USAs) will now provision
 user access to PowerGADS by assigning the PG_M_OPERATOR entitlement/role on each user's behalf through the Market Participant Identity Manager (
MPIM
) application prior to launch.

ACTION REQUIRED: 
Action Required for users from Resource Entities Registered with NERC:

Submit Q1-26, Q2-26, Q3-26, and Q4-26 GADS files via PowerGADS by February 15, 2027 using the attached instructions. The schedule for reporting GADS data to ERCOT will follow the same schedule NERC implements for their GADS submissions as seen below.

The GADS data submitted to ERCOT are considered Protected Information under Nodal Protocols Section 1.3.1.1(1)(q).

Notify your USA to add the PG_M_OPERATOR entitlement to your account along with your preferred email address to gain access. Note that your email address will serve as both your identifier and login credential.

Review the linked Job Aids: 
Setup Stakeholder Login
; 
Stakeholder Login Access for PowerGADS Market Participants
; and 
Manage Multi Factor Authentication for PowerGADS Users

Review the Job Aids and complete the above steps prior to December 4, 2026.

Review Reporting Schedule

Reporting Deadline

Period of Operation to Report 

February 15 

Any updates for prior year 

May 15

Quarter 1: January 1 - March 31 

August 15 

Quarter 2: April 1 - June 30 

November 15 

Quarter 3: July 1 - September 30 

February 15 

Quarter 4: October 1 - December 31 

NOTE FOR USAs for RESOURCE ENTITIES registered with NERC

USAs will provision user access to PowerGADS by assigning the PG_M_OPERATOR entitlement/role through the Market Participant Identity Manager (MPIM)* application.

*Please note, both the Market Participant Identity Manager (MPIM) and Stakeholder Login Portal will be operated in parallel while additional functionality is planned at future dates. Communications will be shared at each stage.

ACTION REQUIRED: USAs - Please Follow The Instructions Below:

Defining MPIM:
 The MIS application used by USAs to manage user access to the MIS. To access MPIM, authenticate with your digital certificate by logging in to the Market Information System (MIS). Assign PowerGADS user access through MPIM using the below steps before December 4th, 2026:

Review the linked 
Manage PowerGADS User Access in MPIM
 Job Aid

To provision access to PowerGADS, the PG_M_OPERATOR entitlement/role will be added to MPIM.

If a user does not already exist, the USA must create the user account. The email address is especially important as part of the account.

A certificate will not be required for PowerGADS access.

The email address must be the user's intended identifier and login credential. For example, Jim Jones could use 
Jim.Jones@comp.com
.

CONTACT:
 If you have any questions regarding PowerGADS data, please contact 
GADSSubmissions@ercot.com
. For general questions contact ERCOT Client Services phone number at (512) 248-3900 or contact ERCOT Client Services via email at 
ClientServices@ercot.com
. For MPIM or Access questions you may contact the Future Ready Identity program at 
IAM2FutureReady@ercot.com
.

If you are receiving email from a public ERCOT distribution list that you no longer wish to receive, please follow this link in order to unsubscribe from this list: 
http://lists.ercot.com
.
